description:
Day 6 came alive with a wonderful burst of colour, music and youthful energy as 14 schools took to the stage at Aryan School for the Folk Dance Competition. More than 400 students, teachers and parents filled the venue, cheering loudly for every performance. Each school brought its own beautiful interpretation of our folk traditions, making the morning a vibrant celebration of culture, talent and teamwork. The performances were judged by Mr. Ganesh, who comes from a strong professional dance background, and the much-awaited results were announced amidst great excitement and applause.
The morning ended on a warm note with snack boxes distributed to all the students, teachers, staff and parents, while Star News was present to cover the celebrations.
